subject: Post-call: LumenAI procurement & cloud marketplace path
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Collins <ava.collins@lumenai.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: LumenAI procurement & cloud marketplace path

Hi Ava / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

Summary:
- LumenAI is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for production inference (initial pilot: 4 A100-equivalent GPUs).
- Procurement preference: PO workflow (finance), internal approval needed from procurement/finance (Tom flagged a 2-3 week review).
- Strong interest in AWS Marketplace option for billing & procurement simplification — you asked if Redwood can list on AWS and offer a Marketplace subscription pricing path.

Action items / asks from your side:
- Confirm whether procurement will require a vendor form + W-9 (Tom mentioned he’d share procurement form).
- Confirm primary procurement owner (name/email) and whether they need a signed SOW or PO-only purchase.
- Target procurement timeline for pilot purchase (we heard ~2-3 weeks).

What we will provide:
- Redwood_Marketplace_Onboarding_Process.pdf (attached) — outlines the steps and timelines to go live on AWS Marketplace.
- Redwood_SaaS_Terms.pdf (attached) — our standard terms; if you need a SOW, we can generate Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf for the pilot.
- Quick pricing note: marketplace subscription mirrors list price; marketplace fees are handled by AWS, we can provide an estimate once you confirm the path.

Proposed next steps:
- Please send procurement form / vendor details (Tom, if you can share) — we’ll fill it out and return.
- If helpful, let’s have a 30-minute procurement touchpoint next week with procurement + finance to speed approvals. I’m available Wed/Thu 9-11am PT.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa (solutions engineer) on sizing details and Jonas (sales manager) on commercial path.

Best,
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Redwood_Marketplace_Onboarding_Process.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: Redwood_SaaS_Terms.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@lumenai.com>
Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 09:08:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: LumenAI procurement & cloud marketplace path

Thanks Camila — great recap. A few quick answers and clarifications: 

- We are definitely interested in the AWS Marketplace option; it would make billing and procurement much easier for our finance team.
- Procurement preference: PO via our AP system (card may be allowed for smaller pilots but finance prefers PO for anything above $5k/month).
- I am the procurement sponsor but Tom (copied) will kick off the vendor onboarding and legal/finance review. I will introduce you to our vendor onboarding contact if needed.
- Procurement will require a vendor form + W-9. They’ll also request SOC 2 and data handling info; do you have a SOC 2 report or an attestation we can share?

Timeline: target decision for the pilot by mid-June; procurement review should take ~2 weeks once they have the paperwork.

Can you provide a draft SOW and an estimate for the first 90 days? Also please confirm if we can subscribe via AWS Marketplace for the pilot and whether the marketplace subscription covers reserved capacity or just hosted subscriptions.

Thanks,
Ava
Head of Procurement, LumenAI
ava.collins@lumenai.com

On Tue, May 30, 2028 at 3:12 PM Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [original message]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 June 2028 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: LumenAI procurement & cloud marketplace path

Hi Ava — great, thanks for the clear answers. Quick responses inline: 

- SOC 2: we have an up-to-date SOC 2 Type II report and a short security FAQ — attaching SOC2_summary.pdf and will send the full attestation via a secure link to your procurement team.
- Marketplace path: yes — AWS Marketplace supports subscription purchases for hosted products. For Dedicated/reserved capacity we can support Marketplace private offers or bring-your-own-contract arrangements; Marissa will advise on the best path for a pilot (she can outline whether Reserved vs hosted subscription fits your usage).
- Pricing / SOW: attaching Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf with a 90-day pilot estimate based on 4 A100-equivalent GPUs and expected token throughput. The SOW includes a one-time onboarding fee + monthly committed capacity pricing. If you decide to purchase via AWS Marketplace, list pricing will be the basis; we can prepare a private offer if you need negotiated pricing.

Proposed procurement touchpoint: Thu Jun 7, 10:00-10:30am PT (30 mins) — I can invite Marissa + Jonas and your procurement contact. Does that work?

I’ll also send a short checklist to fill out the vendor form quickly (company legal name, tax ID, remittance address, PO contact).

Thanks — attaching: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf.

Best,
Camila
Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
